To visit Tokelau, you must obtain a '''permit''' issued by the '''Tokelau Apia Liaison Office''' in Apia, Samoa. This permit is mandatory for all visitors, regardless of their New Zealand visa status. Additionally, all travel to Tokelau is by boat from Samoa, and a permit from the Samoan Immigration Authorities is required to leave and re-enter Samoa.
